On the Hawaiian island of Maui, they'll take a break from each other while living in separate houses with sexy singles to discover if there is another partner with whom they are more compatible. In the end, will the couples leave together? Will they leave with one of the island's "tempters"? Or will they break up and go home alone? Whatever the outcome, there should be plenty of drama along the way. TV-14 Air Date: Oct 10, 2019 See TV Season Details Cast & Crew All Cast Crew Mark L.
